One who truly loves you, who always seeks your welfare, and desires your success in this world and the next,

 Nussun from Breslov

Letters from yesterday I received today properly — through the donkey-driver. And several matters are a wonder to me — that you write to me that Reb Yaakov, may his candle shine, wrote that you should send me nine rubles as a deposit to distribute to the poor of Teverya — as a redemption — and may he be healed, our friend, the man of substance, the veteran Chassid — Morainu v'Rabbainu Reb Abaleh, may his candle shine — and may he shine like the sun at noon.

segments.en: And I will write you immediately a receipt for the money — but I do not know where the money is.

segments.en: And I went to Reb Dov, the trusted one, to ask him — perhaps it is by him — and it is not by him.
